source.text:
Hi Tanaka-san,

Thank you for your letter about the lease renewal. We're happy to accept the 5% rent increase from April. Please send the new lease and I will sign it this week. We would like the renewal to run for two years. The apartment is in good shape, and we have no repairs to report. I can drop off the signed copy on Saturday morning if that works for you.

Best regards,
Mika

notes.title: Lease renewal
notes.text: Lease renewal: Tanaka-san agreed by phone on Nov 20 to a 3% rent increase from April.
